name: Dorm Till Dawn 2
source:
Welcome to St Fiacre's School for Women of Unreliable Size, where only the biggest survive. Unfortunately, you've woken up small, and you've got a long night ahead.

Reeling from the murder of a friend, you have a task ahead: sneak into the dorm of the meanest girl in college and make her pay. That is, if you can avoid getting eaten.

This feature-length interactive visual novel returns to the world of Sensus Supra, with better visuals, dozens of animations, more complex puzzles and even more dangerous giantesses hunting for your blood. Make your choices carefully, because every action has consequences...

Never mind getting your revenge – can you even survive the night in this chilling domain?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4403710/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到圣菲亚克女子身材不可靠学校，这里只有体型最大的人才能生存。不幸的是，你醒得很早，接下来的夜晚还很漫长。

朋友被谋杀后，你面临着一项任务：潜入大学里最卑鄙女孩的宿舍，让她付出代价。也就是说，如果你能避免被吃掉的话。

这部长篇互动视觉小说重返《Sensus Supra》的世界，拥有更好的视觉效果、数十个动画、更复杂的谜题，以及更危险的女巨人猎杀你的血液。谨慎做出选择，因为每一个行动都会产生后果……

别介意复仇——你能在这个令人毛骨悚然的领域熬过一夜吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4403710/]Steam[/url]]
